newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TOOLEX SHARES SLUMP ON WARNING.
newsitem.headline: TOOLEX SHARES SLUMP ON WARNING.

text.p: Shares in Toolex Alpha NV, a Swedish-based manufacturer of systems for production of compact discs, fell sharply on the Amsterdam bourse on Thursday.
The shares, listed in Amsterdam since May, were off 9.40 guilders at 23.00 by 1405 GMT.
The steep fall in the share price followed a warning by the company that revenues for the first nine months of 1996 would be roughly 427 million Swedish crowns.
It said this was below its own expectations and only slightly higher than revenues for the same period in 1995.
Toolex shares are also listed on Nasdaq in the U.S.
Separately the Amsterdam bourse said it was cancelling all deals in Toolex shares conducted before 1330 GMT.
The bourse said it was taking this measure because it strongly suspected that there had been a situation of "inequality of information" prior to the Toolex statement.
